name: Corsair Baron Kasque

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Kasque may use Ruin Actions, and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Flensing Fury
bonuses.text: If Kasque deals a Wound, he gains +2 bonus dice to any Weapon Skill Tests until the end of his next Turn.

bonuses.name: Grave Lotus
bonuses.text: Kasque is currently under the effects of the Grave Lotus Combat Drug, giving him +2 bonus Strength. The bonus Strength has been added to the Strength Attribute above.

bonuses.name: Skyboard
bonuses.text: Whilst mounted on his Skyboard Kasque can Fly at Speed 12 and fire its Splinter Pods as though he were wielding them as a Ranged Weapon. If the Skyboard is damaged, Kasque rolls a Complication, or attempts any kind of difficult aerial manoeuvre, he must succeed a DN 4 Pilot (A) Test or the Skyboard crashes in a random direction according to the Scattering rules. Crashing deals a minimum of d3 Shock and may trigger falling damage.

abilities.name: Hellion Assault
abilities.text: Whilst mounted on a Skyboard, a Hellion may charge as a Combat Action and Fall Back as a Simple Action.

abilities.name: Adrenalight Burst
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin and suffer 3 Shock to immediately make two All Out Attacks, one after another.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion with 2 personal Ruin). Strength 4 already includes the Grave Lotus +2.
